item.title: Trump signs order threatening up to 100% tariffs on pharmaceuticals
item.summary: US President Donald Trump unveiled sweeping new pharmaceutical tariffs on Thursday that could reach 100 percent unless drugmakers strike pricing deals with his administration. The move escalates his trade strategy and could reshape global supply chains and raise costs.
